'''Bimmini''',<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> or '''Bimm''', was the native language of [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|both]] species of [[Bimm/Legends|Bimms]] on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. The two species of Bimms used Bimmini as their official language.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Bimmini was described as a harmonious singsong, sounding like a collection of ballads sung in five-part harmony.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Most Bimms were bilingual, learning to speak and write [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] from a young age.<ref name="AA" />

Notably, non-Bimm speakers of the language included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was highly regarded in Bimm culture, and any Jedi visiting the world was given a grand welcoming ceremony.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
